The LisaGB prior: sky

Where on the sky a source sits: the galactic mixture of sample_sky (a bulge Gaussian, a thick and a thin Laplace disk in (l, sin b), and an isotropic floor), each part on its own and summed, in the galactic, ecliptic and equatorial frames, against the quadrature of sky_log_density; then why the frame matters to LISA, whether the rotations are exact, and how (l, b) reach the flow. The sky does not depend on the band, so there is no band picker. Built 2026-10-30 from data/sky.json.
